text: In this exercise, you are required to Apply and evaluate CNN, ANN, and RNN models Compare their performance and identify the model that achieves the highest accuracy for image classification using the **Iris Flowers dataset**. You will load and preprocess image data, design a multi-layer CNN architecture using TensorFlow/Keras, and train the model to recognize different object categories. After training, you will evaluate the model's performance on unseen test data and visualize the training loss across epochs. The objective of this exercise is to provide hands-on experience with **Deep Learning and Computer Vision**, enabling you to understand the complete workflow of an image classification project. Also solve the Large Language Models (LLMs) Architecture & Work. And Using LLMs with LangChain, passing prompts programmatically.
